title: China’s Space Station
synopsis: From private bedrooms to a “space gym”, what are some of the coolest features of China’s Tiangong Space Station?

fullText.simplified:
中国空间站

    2021年6月17号，神州十二号飞船发射成功，三名宇航员成功入住中国空间站！
    从神十二发射成功到航天员三个月的太空生活，需要三大支持：一是载人神箭——长征二号F火箭，它负责将飞船安全送入太空；二是太空摆渡车——神舟飞船，用于天地往返运送航天员；三是太空快递小哥——天舟飞船，顾名思义，它的主要工作就是运送物资，为本次神舟十二航天员进驻空间站做好生活物资准备。
    既然要住上三个月，那中国航天员的“太空之家”是什么样的呢？
    首先，“大”是重点。
    中国设计师们为航天员预留了相对充裕的生活环境，与2011年发射的“天宫一号”15立方米的空间比，这回的空间站的空间提升到了110立方米，一下子就从“小房间”搬进了“大别墅”。
    其次，中国空间站的设计更加人性化。空间站设置生活区、工作区、太空厨房及就餐区，配备3个独立卧室和1个卫生间。航天员不仅有独立的睡眠区、包裹式淋浴间，还有“太空健身房”。锻炼区配备太空跑台、太空自行车等设施，工作之余还能在太空跑个步、骑个车。而且设计师们给航天员预留了一条私密语音通道，航天员可以在这里和家人打电话“说悄悄话”，分享自己在太空生活的心情。
    再次，在太空中，航天员也能实现“睡觉自由”了，能够享受独立的睡眠区，确保睡觉不受干扰。虽然依然要把自己“装进睡袋”，但已经实现了从“站睡”到“躺睡”的变革了。独立的睡眠区能够让航天员更放松，享受相对高质量的睡眠，让他们的太空工作和生活更加“元气满满”。
    另外，为了保证空间站里航天员的维修和组装工作能够更加准确、高效地完成，设计师们在“防差错设计”上下了不少功夫，确保航天员在太空操作时“不看错、不误操作”。
    最后要重点介绍一下航天员的太空餐。果然是“有一种饿叫祖国妈妈觉得你饿”，“快递小哥”天舟二号运了6吨多货上去！三名航天员要在太空拆160多个包裹的快递，中国空间站的食堂里不仅有120多种食品种类，还准备了各种调味品，折叠桌、加热、冷藏、饮水设备一应俱全，就连冰激凌都带上了太空。
    看了中国航天员的太空之家，你有没有很羡慕呀？相信随着科学的进一步发展，人类早晚能实现入住太空的梦想。
fullText.traditional:
中國空間站

    2021年6月17號，神州十二號飛船發射成功，三名宇航員成功入住中國空間站！
    從神十二發射成功到航天員三個月的太空生活，需要三大支持：一是載人神箭——長征二號F火箭，它負責將飛船安全送入太空；二是太空擺渡車——神舟飛船，用于天地往返運送航天員；三是太空快遞小哥——天舟飛船，顧名思義，它的主要工作就是運送物資，為本次神舟十二航天員進駐空間站做好生活物資準備。
    既然要住上三個月，那中國航天員的“太空之家”是甚麼樣的呢？
    首先，“大”是重點。
    中國設計師們為航天員預留了相對充裕的生活環境，與2011年發射的“天宮一號”15立方米的空間比，這回的空間站的空間提昇到了110立方米，一下子就從“小房間”搬進了“大別墅”。
    其次，中國空間站的設計更加人性化。空間站設置生活區、工作區、太空廚房及就餐區，配備3個獨立臥室和1個衛生間。航天員不僅有獨立的睡眠區、包裹式淋浴間，還有“太空健身房”。鍛鍊區配備太空跑台、太空自行車等設施，工作之餘還能在太空跑個步、騎個車。而且設計師們給航天員預留了一條私密語音通道，航天員可以在這裡和家人打電話“說悄悄話”，分享自己在太空生活的心情。
    再次，在太空中，航天員也能實現“睡覺自由”了，能夠享受獨立的睡眠區，確保睡覺不受干擾。雖然依然要把自己“裝進睡袋”，但已經實現了從“站睡”到“躺睡”的變革了。獨立的睡眠區能夠讓航天員更放鬆，享受相對高質量的睡眠，讓他們的太空工作和生活更加“元氣滿滿”。
    另外，為了保證空間站裡航天員的維修和組裝工作能夠更加準確、高效地完成，設計師們在“防差錯設計”上下了不少功夫，確保航天員在太空操作時“不看錯、不誤操作”。
    最後要重點介紹一下航天員的太空餐。果然是“有一種餓叫祖國媽媽覺得你餓”，“快遞小哥”天舟二號運了6噸多貨上去！三名航天員要在太空拆160多個包裹的快遞，中國空間站的食堂裡不僅有120多種食品種類，還準備了各種調味品，折疊桌、加熱、冷藏、飲水設備一應俱全，就連冰激凌都帶上了太空。
    看了中國航天員的太空之家，你有沒有很羨慕呀？相信隨著科學的進一步發展，人類早晚能實現入住太空的夢想。

sentences.simplified: 中国空间站的食堂里不仅有120多种食品种类，
sentences.traditional: 中國空間站的食堂裡不僅有120多種食品種類，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó kōng jiān zhàn de shí táng lǐ bù jǐn yǒu 4 duō zhǒng shí pǐn zhǒng lèi
sentences.english: The three astronauts will unpack more than 160 packages in space.

sentences.simplified: 还准备了各种调味品，折叠桌、加热、冷藏、饮水设备一应俱全，
sentences.traditional: 還準備了各種調味品，折疊桌、加熱、冷藏、飲水設備一應俱全，

sentences.english: .. it is also fully equipped with all kinds of seasoning, folding tables, heaters, refrigerators, and water dispensers.
Even ice cream has been brought into space.

sentence_translations: China’s Space Station
On June 17, 2021, the Shenzhou-12 spacecraft was successfully launched, ..
.. and three astronauts successfully entered the Chinese space station!
From the successful launch of the Shenzhou-12 to the three months the astronauts will spend in space, ..
.. three pillars of support are needed.
First is the manned Divine Arrow rocket, the Long March 2F, responsible for safely sending the ship to space.
Second is the space shuttle Shenzhou, used to transport the astronauts from earth to space and back again.
Third is the “space courier”, the Tianzhou spacecraft.
As the name implies, its main job is to transport supplies, ..
.. preparing supplies for the Shenzhou-12 astronauts living in the space station.
Since they will spend three months there, what does the “space home” of the Chinese astronauts look like?
First, the main point is that it is “big”.
The Chinese designers set aside a relatively spacious living environment for the astronauts.
Compared with the 15-cubic-meter “Tiangong-1” launched in 2011, ..
..  this time, the space station’s total living space has been increased to 110 cubic meters, ..
.. at once turning a “small room” into a “big villa”.
Second, the space station features a more human-centered design.
It includes a living area, a working area, a “space kitchen”, and a dining area, ..
.. and is equipped with three separate bedrooms and one bathroom.
The astronauts have not only their own separate sleeping areas and a “wrapped shower room”, but also a “space gym”.
The exercise area is equipped with facilities such as a “space treadmill” and “space bicycle”.
So after work, they can also take a jog or ride a bike in space.
Moreover, the designers have set aside a private voice channel for the astronauts.
The astronauts can call family members and have private conversations here, ..
.. sharing their feelings about living in space.
Third, astronauts can also achieve “freedom of sleep” in space.
They can enjoy separate sleeping areas to ensure undisturbed sleep.
Although they still have to “wrap themselves in a sleeping bag”, ..
.. they’ve already achieved a transformation from “sleeping while standing” to “sleeping while lying down”.
The separate sleeping areas allow the astronauts to feel more relaxed and enjoy better quality sleep, ..
.. making their life and work in space even more “full of vigor”.
In addition, to ensure the astronauts’ maintenance and assembly work in the station is completed more accurately and efficiently, ..
.. the designers put a lot of effort into “error-proof design”.
This is to ensure that when astronauts work in space, they “won’t misinterpret what they see and make mistakes”.
Finally is a brief introduction to what the astronauts eat in space.
Sure enough, there is a type of hunger that is called “your motherland thinks you’re hungry”.
The “space courier” Tianzhou-2 has transported more than 6 tons of goods to the space station!
The three astronauts will unpack more than 160 packages in space.
The dining area of the Chinese space station not only has more than 120 kinds of food, ..
.. it is also fully equipped with all kinds of seasoning, folding tables, heaters, refrigerators, and water dispensers.
Even ice cream has been brought into space.
Now that you’ve learned about the space home of Chinese astronauts, are you jealous?
I believe that with the further development of science, humanity will one day achieve the dream of living in space.
